title: Building Code of Pakistan 2021
notes: BCP 2021 states that referenced codes form part of its requirements to the prescribed extent. Its plumbing provision states that IPC applies unless not required by the AHJ.

title: 2021 International Plumbing Code — Chapter 6 Water Supply and Distribution
notes: Chapter 6 governs design and installation of hot and cold water supply systems and individual water-supply systems; it includes water-supply, design, material, installation, hot-water, potable protection and temperature-control provisions.

title: 2021 International Plumbing Code — Appendix E Sizing of Water Piping System
jurisdiction: International fallback / only where adopted or otherwise applicable
notes: Appendix E states that it is not mandatory unless specifically referenced in the adopting ordinance. It provides water-piping sizing procedures based on available static pressure, elevation/head changes, friction and fixture flow requirements.

title: ASHRAE Handbook—Fundamentals 2025, Chapter 3 Fluid Flow
notes: Engineering reference for fluid-flow fundamentals used by the hydraulic calculation layer.

title: ASHRAE Handbook—Fundamentals 2025, Chapter 22 Pipe and Tube Design
notes: Provides a pipe-system sizing workflow, discusses service-water diversity, pipe materials and hydraulic losses, and notes Darcy-Weisbach as an alternative to pressure-drop charts. It cautions about extending Hazen-Williams C values outside their original conditions.

title: ASHRAE Handbook—HVAC Applications 2023, Chapter 51 Service Water Heating
notes: Relevant to hot-water recirculation: system planning, flow/temperature requirements, hot-water pipe sizing, pressure differential, heat-loss/recirculation concepts and controls. The chapter warns that some demand data may be outdated and should be treated appropriately.
